newsitem.title: USA: HFS CFO says 97 EPS estimate is reasonable.
newsitem.headline: HFS CFO says 97 EPS estimate is reasonable.

text.p: HFS Inc's Chief Financial Officer Michael Monaco said that he sees 1997 earnings per share estimates of around $2.58, as forecast by Montgomery Securities' analyst Michael Mueller, as being "reasonable."
Speaking at a Montgomery Securities Hospitality Conference he also said that the 29 percent EPS growth target set by the analyst "approximates our growth targets."
The company reported 1996 earnings of $1.34 per share excluding charges.
Monaco said the company was on track to complete its PHH Corp merger in March and added that "we plan to continue acquisition efforts" going forward.
He also said that analysts could expect to see further announcements detailing the impact of the acquisition in coming months.

HFS and PHH announced a definitive merger agreement in November 1996, under which HFS would acquire PHH in a deal worth about $1.7 billion. The deal is expected to be immediately accretive to HFS's EPS.
